digest.component_or_area: rebar bridge facade and MCP interface
propositions: Bridge operations must be exported as typed public library functions and real MCP tools, reusing the shared run_pass() / _Disposition core without duplicating route or exit-code logic

Legacy rebar.reconcile(mode=...) and bridge_fsck() must remain callable with unchanged signatures, defaults, return types, exceptions, and mutation boundaries while semantically mapping to new bridge operations

New MCP bridge tools require explicit typed inputs and output schemas, with mcp.allow_jira_sync gating every mutating route but not blocking read-only preview, status, fsck, or access-check operations

Compatibility adapters must preserve published contracts at the public boundary (subprocess-visible return shape, CLI exit codes, exception behavior) without forcing old callers onto new internal shapes
New library and MCP surfaces must achieve surface-parity across CLI reference semantics, typed library imports, real MCP registration/schema boundaries, and automated legacy caller continuity
